scope: Complete candidate-only guided service configuration and reading-first layout. No product, DDL, API, native engine, download, canonical source or approved visual changes.
catalog_generation: guided-catalog.js copies the separately reviewed presentation JSON exactly, with an explicit source identity and unchanged registry protocol metadata. No second hand-written field schema.
selection_boundary: One shared picker in session and HUD. Only saved translation-purpose resources enter the daily list. Never list unadded built-in templates or unsaved drafts.
configuration_boundary: Configuration editors add, edit, save and test resources. Saving never chooses a service or enables automatic translation. Each explicit selection freezes that saved resource version.
purpose_boundary: Explicit templatePurpose translation and compatible capability; grammar and contextual word configurations remain separate. Native offline engines are translation-only.
availability_boundary: Incomplete fields, matching known test failure, disabled connection and unsupported capability block selection. Valid untested HTTP configurations remain explicitly unverified and selectable. Native engines require matching configuration/resource/route and current health; unknown defaults block.
scope_boundary: Global default and per-game override are separate selections. Per-game changes do not overwrite global. Restore inheritance is explicit. Selection preserves automatic translation state and affects subsequent lines; current-line retranslation remains independent and keeps original history.
comparison_boundary: Each record captures independent per-engine status, result and reason; the page-external comparison tool simulates one engine response. Primary failure does not derive comparison status. Pending invalid identities reject late responses. No production scheduler is implemented.
lifecycle_boundary: Deletion confirmation immediately revokes the deleted model and dependent connections, even before editor save; frozen historical provenance remains. Explicit automatic translation stop updates scoped enablement separately from selected resources. Configuration return uses the captured game context, even if the active session changes.
explicit_request_boundary: With automatic translation disabled, an explicit current/history sentence request is a narrowly scoped page-local mock. It captures a unique record, game and selected version, leaves effective and automatic enablement disabled, preserves the parent record and never overwrites a different current sentence. Automatic-on requests still reuse the canonical prototype flow.
guided_configuration_boundary: Choose user purpose, named brand and precise interface. Only catalog-applicable necessary fields appear in the primary form. Advanced, typed credential groups and learning bindings remain reachable. Known preset material blockers stay distinct from user-required fields; no implicit interface fallback.
secret_boundary: Masked form values live only in a private page-local Map. Drafts/snapshots/test records contain opaque design references only. Portable export strips these references and test records. No real credentials are used.
reading_boundary: Canonical current sentence and translation keep their own visible card and comparison attachment point. Body history, all extraction and Hook diagnostics follow the reading/preview area in that order, initially collapsed. Each view retains independent query/filter/page/follow/new-count/export state; folding never removes events or rebuilds the shared preview.
simulation_boundary: All service tests, credential checks and native availability observations are explicitly labeled page-local design simulations. No HTTP, OAuth, filesystem scan, download, protocol adapter, native API or DLL runs. Unknown local conditions remain blocked.
approval: Pending user review. No product/native/service/storage/game/release acceptance or historical approval is promoted.
policy_scope_boundary: Context, timeout, concurrency, retry, fallback and cache remain purpose-layer drafts. Resource forms only link to explicitly labeled purpose settings and never mutate existing bindings. Purpose overrides and previews resolve their actual bound service/scope; draft and applied policies are shown separately.
test_identity_boundary: Each resource has an independent cancellable design test job. Request-field changes settle stale tasks; observations, display names, revisions and per-pool test results are excluded from request identity and cannot erase known failures.
